visual_action: A slideshow of three still images of politicians. The first is Kamala Harris sitting in a chair. The second is a headshot of Tim Walz smiling. The third is Donald Trump on a golf course wearing a 'Make America Great Again' hat.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: An image of Kamala Harris is shown with overlay text attributing accomplishments to her.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: An image of Tim Walz is shown with overlay text attributing accomplishments to him.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: An image of Donald Trump is shown with overlay text attributing negative actions to him.

on_screen_text.text: Kamala Harris: I capped the cost of insulin, reduced prescription drug prices, and am fighting for reproductive rights
Tim Walz: I expanded mental health resources for students, and signed a $2.3 billion education budget
Donald Trump: I overturned Roe v. Wade and spread racist conspiracy theories about immigrants 😬

spoken_summary: The audio is a popular sound clip featuring a conversation between an adult woman and children. The woman asks what they made. One child says they made a smoothie, another says they made bacon. When a third child, Sophie, is asked what she made, she replies, "I didn't make anything."
audio_music: The audio is a popular, comedic meme sound clip taken from another video. It is dialogue only, with no music, used to create a metaphorical comparison between the politicians shown.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of three static images, with cuts timed to the beats of the overlaid audio dialogue.
cultural_references: The audio is a popular TikTok sound/meme often referred to as 'I didn't make anything' or 'Sophie, what did you make?' used to compare productive people with someone who has accomplished nothing.
central_claim: Democratic politicians like Kamala Harris and Tim Walz deliver positive results, while Donald Trump has only produced negative outcomes.
intended_effect: To create a feeling of pride in Democratic accomplishments while mocking Donald Trump and portraying him as ineffectual and destructive.
